learning_outcomes.text: Identifies the operation of the mechanical systems of an automobile. Evaluates the influence of each system on the behavior of the automobile.
Understands the automobile conception process. Understands the automobile manufacturing process.

syllabus_topics: Interaction with the rolling surface. tires
Dynamics of vehicles equipped with suspension (vertical dynamics)
Tests and trials applied to automobiles
Legislation and regulations applied to automobiles
teaching_methods: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom
assessment_rules: The resit will consist of an exam covering the course contents. Continuous assessment results may be considered if they are favorable to the student.
bibliography: Masato Abe, Vehicle Handling Dynamics. Theory and application, 2009, Elsevier Ltd.
John C. Dixon , Tyres, Suspension and Handling, 1994, Cambridge University Press.
